svg.title: StreamDecisionBench — in-force accuracy across update intervals
svg.desc: 30 single-model settings, 13 cloud APIs and 17 self-hosted open-weight settings. Normalized log-AUC over update intervals of 0.5–8 seconds; one pass for each Wity mode and three for all other settings.
svg.text: The curves beneath the leaderboard score · Logarithmic interval weighting from 0.5 to 8 s
